trap-nonspeakable.notes: pass. THREE FINDINGS, none fixed inline. (1) THE LEAN THE REF RESOLVES TO IS A TAUTOLOGY THAT SHADOWS A REAL PROOF. lean.ref is qou:QOU.OptimalNF.optimal_nf_is_standard_basis, and TWO declarations of that exact name exist in that exact namespace. The library one, lean/QOU/Archimedean/OptimalNF.lean:257, is substantive — it takes h_stable : valleyOfStability Z N and h_pos, and concludes an existential over prefix-closed supports whose non-I9-absorbable words lie in standardBasis (Z+N-1), discharged from nf_support_prefix_closed and optimal_from_prefix_closed. The sibling one, predicted-spectra/optimal-normal-form-valley.lean:46, is what AGENTS.md 0a resolution reaches FIRST, and it states 'exists c : Fin (massNumber Z N) -> R, forall i, c i = markovVolume i q' proved by 'exact <fun i => markovVolume i q, fun _ => rfl>'. That is 'there exists a function equal to this function' — true for any function whatsoever, with markovVolume declared 'opaque'. Both hypotheses, hq : q > 1 and hval : inValley Z N, are UNUSED, which is the operational test AGENTS.md's Strict Lean Discipline item 5 gives for a banned tautological conclusion. Nothing about Groebner--Shirshov reduction, the I8/I9 ideals, the valley of stability, or the term count is encoded. The .ts marking validation 'stub' is partial honesty, but 1a's honest dispositions are prove / state-with-sorry-plus-Ref / demote to conjecture — a rfl-provable existential is none of the three. Proposed: delete the sibling so the ref resolves to the library theorem (0a's 'no shadowing stubs' says exactly this when the real formalisation exists), or restate the sibling with sorry and a -- Ref:. (2) SYMBOL COLLISION IN THE THEOREM STATEMENT: 'For any nucleus $N(Z, N)$ with $N \geq Z - 1$' uses N as both the nucleus and the neutron count, twice in one line. The chapter's own convention elsewhere is calligraphic — prop:nuclear-spin-parity writes $\mathcal{N}(Z, N)$ — and this block uses $\mathcal{N}_{opt}$ in its own display two lines later. Proposed: $\mathcal{N}(Z,N)$. (3) 'valley of stability ($N \geq Z - 1$)' is a very loose reading of the valley: it excludes only proton-rich nuclides and admits arbitrarily neutron-rich ones, so it is a half-plane rather than a valley. The Lean agrees with the .md (inValley Z N := N + 1 >= Z), so this is a definitional choice rather than a transcription error, but the name oversells it.
